notes.title: Free New DLC - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706554/f92004be9f16ff92ac33e4368ffef1194a105243.png[/img]

[h1]Free New DLC is now live![/h1]

[/list]
Play the DLC now for free!

notes.title: Patch 1.1b
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706554/f92004be9f16ff92ac33e4368ffef1194a105243.png[/img]

[h2]Bugfixes [Basegame]:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the Autodriller where Hagax and Kolsum were obtained before unlocking the 2nd Mining Ground.
[*] Corrected a typo in the Library where the text indicated a payment of 100 Credits instead of the required 250 Credits.
[*] Removed the line "Later that night..." when going to bed to avoid confusion or the expectation of something special happening.
[*] Updated the completion text for repairs in each section to include a unique thank you from each girl.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes [DLC]:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the DLC that caused the game to crash in one particular scene.
[/list]

notes.title: OUTMINER is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706554/2b78149bd3f206de6060a65ac6c0c2ede709db75.png[/img]


[h3]I'm excited to announce that OUTMINER is Steam Deck Verified and is now playable on Steam Deck!

When you lay your hands on Valve's new console, you'll be able to bring OUTMINER's adventure with you anywhere you go! Isn't that convenient?[/h3]
